scheme_name: Uniform Allowance to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a ward of an unemployed ex‑serviceman (ESM) or a ward of the widow of an ESM
Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
Ward must be studying in a government‑recognized institution
Scheme is applicable for up to two wards per unemployed ESM or widow of an ESM
Application must be submitted offline within three months from the date of completion of the education
benefits_summary: Uniform allowance of ₹2,000 per annum for school‑level students and ₹2,500 per annum for other courses, reimbursed up to the actual cost, credited to the beneficiary’s bank account via RTGS/NEFT.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
